alice: FYI hit a streaming teardown bug in the py-sdk while testing the onboarding sample app. Canceling an async generator causes the cleanup callback to run twice and the underlying socket stays open on linux. Repro in sample-app.
ben: can you paste a minimal repro?
alice: here's the core repro:
```
async def stream_tokens(client):
    try:
        async for chunk in client.stream(...):
            yield chunk
    finally:
        await client._on_close()  # explicit cleanup
```
When the caller cancels iteration the finally runs and the StreamWrapper's weakref.finalize also fires -> double-cleanup.
carol: two cleanup paths is the problem: explicit finally + weakref finalizer in StreamWrapper. The cleanup routine isn't idempotent.
sam_devex: only async streams? what sdk version?
alice: async only. repro on python-sdk 0.8.1 and nightly. sync iterator doesn't attach the weakref.
michael: likely introduced when we changed typed return from AsyncIterator[str] to AsyncIterator[Token] and added a wrapper to satisfy typing. That wrapper attaches a finalize but doesn't mark the stream closed.
ben: fix: centralize cleanup into _close_stream() and set _closed = True; make on_close early-return if _closed. consider removing weakref.finalize or make it defensive.
sam_devex: add unit test for double-finalize and mypy stub check.
alice: opened WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py/pull/1239
ci-bot: Pull request 1239 opened by alice: tests queued.
carol: repro command: `pytest tests/stream_teardown.py::test_double_finalize -q` failing with:
```
E       AssertionError: socket still open after generator finalizer ran twice
E       socket fd=45 state=ESTABLISHED
```
ben: i'll own the patch, make idempotent close + update docstring about why weakref was used originally.
sam_devex: also update stubs under py-sdk/stubs/ to keep AsyncIterator[Token] and add maintainer note.
michael: i'll add a typing comment to PR.
alice: this was making onboarding stream demos flaky, so a quick fix would help.
ben: aiming to merge fix + tests today, will report back here.
sam_devex: after merge, please add a short entry in docs/devex/streaming-edgecases.md to help onboarding folks. :thumbsup:
michael: :thumbsup:
